subject: DeWALT impact driver kit $278 vs. Mac Tools kit $449.99
summary: A DeWALT 20V MAX brushless impact driver kit at $278 next to Mac Tools' impact driver kit at $449.99.
body: Today's pick: the DeWALT 20V MAX brushless 1/4" impact driver kit (DCF787C1, 3.5Ah + 1.5Ah batteries) is $278 at ToolNut, marked down from $378. Mac Tools lists its MCF886GP1D1 20V MAX 1/4" brushless impact driver kit at $449.99. That's $171.99 less, about 38%.
They're different tools, so compare torque, battery platform and warranty before you switch. If you already run DeWALT 20V batteries, this one's easy math.
Tip: ToolNut posts a new 24-hour doorbuster around 3 AM ET each day, so check back. Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
